node.statement: Nodes 1.5.1 through 1.5.4 compose the local proof of node 1.5: 1.5.1 gives row reproduction for p_{u_r}; 1.5.2 converts that equality into chart coordinates; 1.5.3 identifies the s-coordinate as delta_{s r} by basis uniqueness; and 1.5.4 uses r != s to make that coordinate zero. Therefore the statement of node 1.5 follows without using sibling node 1.4 as a dependency.
